children.game_version: A community circle game mimicking animal movements like gazelles or growing violet flowers in rhythm with music.

seniors.counts: Counted in steady 4/4 or slow 6/8 time.
seniors.seated_version: Perform hand and arm articulation exercises, wrist rotations, and upper body framing while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Executed with wall or chair support for balance, focusing on gentle stepping without jumps or rapid floor drops.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo with limited range of arm motion and elimination of fast running steps.

feedback_rules.description: Check arm height consistency across the circle formation during Yally.

learning_units.description: Yally Circle Step: Step in 6/8 meter while maintaining hand-to-hand connection with neighbors.

prerequisites.description: Basic cardiovascular endurance and lateral stability for circle stepping.

social_formats.description: Large group circle formation with locked hands or shoulders.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Women's arms and hands use complex, graceful movements, wrist rotations, and handkerchief holds; group dancers hold hands or shoulders
movement_profile.footwork: Men's footwork features rising onto the toes and dropping to the knees; group circle steps involve synchronized walking and running
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Concentric circles, lines, triangles, and solo/couple staging
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso with expressive upper body movement and facial expressions
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes jumps in wedding dances like Asma Kasma and floor-level knee drops in men's dances
movement_profile.partnering: Group connection via hand-holds or shoulder-holds; couple dances featuring graceful courtship and respectful distance
movement_profile.posture: Upright posture with proud head carriage for men; graceful, fluid upper body posture for women

signature_moves.description: Participants hold hands or shoulders in a large ring, synchronously raising and lowering arms while stepping.
signature_moves.name: Yally circle hold

signature_moves.description: Male dancers rise onto their toes with agility and swiftly drop down to their knees.
signature_moves.name: Toe and knee drop

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Gradual acceleration from slow, flowing intros to rapid, energetic conclusions

music_profile.sound_description: Characterized by quick tempos and traditional eastern melodies driven by the reedy tone of the balaban and the punchy accents of nagara drums.

basic_steps: Synchronous step-touch and walking steps in circle formations
Toe-raises and knee-drops for male physical displays
Hand articulation and wrist rotations for female upper body expression
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic group Yally circle steps focusing on hand holds and steady meter before advancing to intricate hand movements and rapid footwork.
